steps.content: You cast your shackles over and over again, checking for Kelvin and Macchiato's presence.
The fact that they're still around gives you some comfort, but also depresses you.
You recall their nervous but excited expressions when you asked them to join this mission, but now, you don't even know where they are.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I know you're suffering right now. Perhaps nothing I say will ease your pain.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But you must know that... the fact that you're still here means we haven't lost.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: There's only one way out, and that's forward.
Cabernet comes up to you, still as tall and graceful as the first time you saw her.
She reaches out her hand to you.

options: You grab her hand and stand up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes... no matter what, I must keep going forward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The only way to bring back everyone... is to march on and confront that chef.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Mmm, that's the spirit. That's how you should be.
You brace yourself and walk out of the locked room.
You suddenly realize that the entire level is now empty.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have they all been eliminated?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What happened here...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The rules are all at McGrath's discretion, so this development is unsurprising...
You've also considered this possibility before...
But... you take a glance at Cabernet.
To keep going forward, you must... eliminate Cabernet.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Oh my, I don't believe it... You made it this far? Haven't given up yet?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: And... you're even here with Miss Cabernet!
You hear that infuriating voice again, but this time without any static. You look up and spot her standing by the elevator close by.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You have the audacity to show up...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Of course! Why wouldn't I?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You really think you made it here on your own?! You think you're still qualified to win?!
McGrath glares at you sullenly, her eyes full of discontent.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Reflect upon your behavior and how you made this far!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: If Miss Cabernet hadn't been protecting you all the way, you would've died in the pool back on the top floor!
A loud noise accompanies McGrath's roar. The entire elevator lobby collapses, and seawater floods the surrounding area, turning it into a lone island.
The floor between you and the lone island cracks and collapses, turning into a "sea trench."

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: To crash this party with an invitation that doesn't belong to you, accompanied by hedonistic and cowardly companions... and now, to utter some nice-sounding nonsense only after the bad things have happened...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I've been watching you. I've been wanting to eliminate you this whole time... You obviously don't fully trust Miss Cabernet. Why do you still keep sticking to her side?!
McGrath looks over at Cabernet, her eyes instantly softening and filling with yearning. She's clearly reluctant to shift away her longing gaze.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: She's so noble and kind and perfect... Her words have always steered my efforts! Yet why does she like you so much?! Why does she protect you even though you have never trusted her!?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: She's the best and most precious guest here! Only she deserves to be the sole winner of this game! Even if... even if she cheats on your behalf to make you "resurrect" again and again...
Gritting her teeth, McGrath presses the strange fish statue next to the elevator.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: But I know it's because Miss Cabernet is too kind... So out of respect for her kindness, we'd better get back to the game and let the rules decide who wins.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Miss Cabernet, there are only two of you left. At this depth, I'm afraid your little grapes don't work anymore...
The churning roar gets closer and closer, accompanied by the smell of sea salt. Water starts to gather around your feet...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh no! She wants to flood the entire floor!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: This is Ogygia Villa, the legendary depths of the ocean! I hope you make up your mind before you drown...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You know it. It's not a nice feeling...
You take Cabernet to higher ground, but know that it's just a temporary fix. The cold water is quickly rising.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Hahaha, make your final decision!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I know you want to win. But now, how exactly will you achieve that? Hahahaha!
You clench your fists, digging your nails into your palms as you think about what to do next.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Sacrifice Miss Cabernet and let her turn into food? But she's been helping you all this time! Are you really going to do that?

options: How do you know I wouldn't do that?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Sigh... Think about it a bit more, then.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Good heavens! I don't believe any honorable person would do that, right?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Or... you can obediently turn into food, and become the most delicious and honorable soul for the dinner banquet that Miss Cabernet and I will enjoy later.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Of course, you can just simply do nothing and drown.

The ice-cold water is now ankle-deep. Your line of sight is dominated by the trench before you, yet no one can help you cross it. Biting your lip, you wrack your brain for ideas on how to foil McGrath's plot.

A shadow casts over you, interrupting your wild thoughts. You realize that you're in Cabernet's shadow as she wades into the water. She's telling you with her eyes that she wants to try to talk to McGrath.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wh-what are you going to do? Miss Cabernet...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Miss Cabernet! Don't worry, tonight... I will present you the most unforgettable feast! You will definitely approve of me! I'm sure of it!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: How can you be sure... that the souls you give me... I will eat and approve of as the most delicious?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Huh...? Because they are the most honorable souls!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And what is "honorable" by your definition?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: A-an honorable soul... is of course compassionate and honest, noble and flawless, and can resist temptation...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ha... I don't think even I can meet those standards.

You have no idea what she's trying to get at. She's as composed and elegant as ever, but with an extra hint of mystery you can't figure out. She no longer looks in your direction, nor responds to your questions.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: No! Of course not! To me, you're the most honorable one of all! You're perfection itself, Miss Cabernet!
Cabernet glides forward, her dress floating behind her like a mermaid's tail.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: <size=32>Those born in Syndicate can be selfless, to your surprise. What he chose to exchange with might have been his most precious possession—that flower might be from the girl he fancies, and the paper on the table might have contained a poem he spent a week composing.</size>

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: <size=32>People first and foremost have the will to survive. It's only natural for them to put their own life over others when they are on the verge of death themselves. Occasional fear is not shameful, and the pursuit of happiness is not some heinous crime.</size>

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Whether it is beauty and ugliness, tears and laughter, tradition and innovation, yummy and yucky tastes...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: These are all but subjectivities born out of human nature.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You stand in a place of arrogance, and use my name to evaluate others... Hmph. Who gave you that right?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Who are you to judge anyone else?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: But... but I...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I just wanted to give you the best souls there are! Isn't that what suits your taste? I... I've read so much about you to find that out!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Only the purest, kindest, and noblest souls in the world are worthy of your taste! I did this all for you...!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: For me?
Cabernet laughs softly, as if having heard a huge joke.
She motions for you to come next to her and face McGrath together.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The "honorable souls" I seek are not something judged by your superficial and self-righteous criteria.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Countless thoughts brew in the heart of the soul. It is also home to the cowardice, poverty, doubt and ignorance you despise.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Why are you saying these things... You never said anything bad about us. You're so decent and honorable... You've guided me... You've stood with me...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Because you don't understand. Amidst all the complex thoughts and emotions, every pure and authentic soul... is worthy of my heart. They all shine brightly and exude exquisite flavor.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Yet you...
Cabernet stands on the edge of the abyss, glaring at McGrath in disdain.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I once praised your skills... but I never thought...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: That your soul is so disgusting. It makes me want to vomit. How truly unappetizing.
McGrath freezes—it seems as if she has even stopped breathing.
Her eyes widen, staring at the person she admires most looking back at her in disgust. Cabernet's words are echoing in her mind, stabbing her insides.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I'm the one who knows her best! I won't be judged by a fake! You... you're dishonorable! You're not Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You... you must have done something! Fess up! Give me the real Miss Cabernet! I'm going to eliminate you!
As soon as she blurts out those words, McGrath freezes on the spot. She reaches out a trembling hand towards Cabernet, saying over and over again that she didn't mean it.
But Cabernet doesn't care. She looks triumphantly at the piteous chef and flashes the smile of a victor.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: There you go. Game over. You did well, McGrath.
The roar that had vanished reappears. A strong sense of unease overwhelms you.
Countless vines suddenly shoot out from the trench before you and wrap around Cabernet!
...The game is over! Because McGrath announced that she was eliminating Cabernet... you have become the final victor!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't move!! Take my hand!!
You rush forward and grab Cabernet's wrist, but the vine slaps your hand away, leaving behind a red mark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You helped me cheat again! I don't want this kind of victory! I don't want you to sacrifice yourself!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be some other way! As long as you and I are both still here!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's fine. I trust you.
Cabernet looks at you with mellow eyes, as if gazing at her favorite dish.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: There has never been a standard to judge whether a soul is "honorable" or not. Such games and rules are a joke to begin with.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Neither you nor I want to play by such rules, so...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Go and "win" this stupid game...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I trust you. As long as you're still here... I know you'll save your treasure, as well as mine.
The vines devour Cabernet, and continue to grow rapidly!
They shoot out of the watery trench, intertwining to form a bridge to the lone island.
McGrath's voice is hoarse and filled with rage. She yells hysterically in the direction where Cabernet disappeared:

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: No!!! You sacrificed yourself... for him?! You did this all for him?!
steps.female_content: No!!! You sacrificed yourself... for her?! You did this all for her?!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You're truly selfless... a real martyr! Miss Cabernet, I was wrong! You're the most honorable soul there is! You, and only you!
McGrath's shrieks echo throughout the villa. Her plans have been completely ruined.
But she can't violate the rules she personally set for herself and the game participants.
Amidst her angry curses and neurotic wails, you step on the black path to the final gate.
You're going to bring back everyone important who has been taken from you.
